Answer: B
Reason: The first image (3-year-old) displays multiple cystic spaces predominantly in the subpleural regions of the upper lobes accompanied by linear interstitial thickening, characteristic of early-stage Langerhans cell histiocytosis. The second image (12-year-old) shows clear lung fields with no visible cysts or interstitial abnormalities, indicating a resolution or different presentation compared to the younger patient.
